GPTR-F-001-S177.title: Allowlist Schema and Request Contract Definition
GPTR-F-001-S177.description: Define a strict request/response contract and allowlist schema for GPTReader operations, including permitted collections, fields, operators, and limits, enforced via Pydantic models.

GPTR-F-001-S178.title: Core Allowlist Enforcement Engine
GPTR-F-001-S178.description: Implement the core enforcement logic that validates incoming GPTReader requests against the allowlist schema, rejecting disallowed collections, fields, operators, and excessive limits before query execution.

GPTR-F-001-S179.title: Azure Function Middleware Integration
GPTR-F-001-S179.description: Integrate the allowlist enforcement engine into the Azure Function request pipeline so that all GPTReader requests are validated prior to any database interaction.

GPTR-F-001-S180.title: Unit and Negative Security Test Coverage
GPTR-F-001-S180.description: Develop comprehensive unit and negative tests to validate enforcement behavior, including rejection of unauthorized fields, operators, injection attempts, and boundary violations.

GPTR-F-001-S181.title: End-to-End Integration with Tooling and Auth Layer
GPTR-F-001-S181.description: Validate that enforced GPTReader requests operate correctly with existing authentication (Bearer token) and upstream tool routing, ensuring only compliant queries reach downstream services.
